item.title: Trump envoy Kushner arrives in Israel after rare Hamas talks on Gaza peace plan
item.description:
US envoy Jared Kushner met with Hamas’ leader in Egypt on Sunday to push for the group’s disarmament, as Washington attempts to salvage the stalled plan to end one of the region’s ongoing conflicts. Kushner is also expected to meet on Monday with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who rejected US President Donald Trump’s peace plan. Israel has also rejected US calls to withdraw from Gaza and Lebanon, demanding that Hamas and Hezbollah disarm first . Israeli forces bombed Lebanon on Sunday in strikes that Iran regards as violations of a months-old ceasefire, adding pressure to faltering US-Iran negotiations: The White House is searching for new strategies to inflict economic pain on Tehran as Washington prepares measures aimed at creating “ economic isolation .” — Brendan Ruberry

item.title: Thieves steal Renaissance artworks in museum heist during Italian holiday
item.description:
Roberto Serra - Iguana Press / Roberto Serra, Getty Images Thieves stole four works by Sicilian Renaissance painter Antonello da Messina from the MuMe regional museum in Sicily during Ferragosto, a major Italian public holiday. On Saturday evening, just before 10 p.m., they evaded the museum’s alarm and security systems and made off with three of the five surviving panels of the 1473 San Gregorio Polyptych, and a double-sided Virgin Mary and Pietà panel taken from an armored display case, according to the news agency LaPresse. “We are devastated by what happened. They were two of Antonello da Messina’s most important and best-known works. It is a tremendous loss for the museum, the city, the community and the art world,” MuMe director Marisa Mercurio said. item.title: Ebola outbreak in Democratic Republic of the Congo now deadliest in country’s history
item.description:
The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo spread to a sixth province as the overall death toll surpassed 2,100 and cases topped 4,500. Experts say the virus may have been transmitted undetected for months, while health workers have struggled to contain the outbreak with poor medical supplies and no approved vaccine for the new strain — though several are in the works. The head of the World Health Organization this week warned that the current outbreak threatens to be the biggest ever, with authorities playing catch-up to the disease after “ a big head start. ” During the previous deadliest outbreak, which killed 11,000 people between 2014 and 2016, authorities had recorded 755 cases at the same point . — Jeronimo Gonzalez

item.title: Ukraine launches one of its largest aerial attacks of the war, killing at least 6 people in Russia
item.description:
People spend time near the river as a helicopter collects water to extinguish the fire that broke out in a distribution warehouse near Moscow, Russia, after Ukraine's drone attack on Aug. 16, 2026. —Stringer/Anadolu—Getty Images Ukraine launched one of its largest aerial assaults on Russia overnight on Saturday, firing on targets deep inside the country and killing at least six people, according to Russian authorities. Russia’s defense ministry said it destroyed 822 drones. Sergei Sobyanin, the mayor of Moscow, said in a Telegram post that at least 600 drones were launched toward the capital city and that over a third were destroyed. The raid showcased the rapid advancement of Ukraine’s drone and missile capabilities in recent months, which enabled it to strike deep inside Russian territory despite the country’s advanced defense networks. item.title: Palestinian-American travels to West Bank home encircled by Israeli settler
item.description:
As a general rule, I support Israel in its conflicts with adversaries like Hamas, Hezbollah and Iran. While I am no great fan of either the present Israeli government or the ideology of Zionism, Israel upholds liberal democratic values to a far greater extent than any of its enemies, and their victory would be a terrible catastrophe. Thus, I've even gone so far as to argue that it is a mistake for the Israelis to make hostage exchange deals with groups like Hamas, because doing so encourages more more terrorism. But it is also important to remember that not all Israeli actions are just, and that Palestinian Arabs also have human rights that must be respected. This is one of those times where these points must be emphasized. item.title: Republican senator denounces Trump’s ‘crazy, stupid’ claims about MMR vaccine safety
item.description:
When President Donald Trump signed an executive order on childhood vaccines this week, Jayme Franklin stood nearby, repeatedly touching her pregnant belly. Franklin, 28, gave brief remarks at the signing and applauded Trump’s order, which seeks to reduce the number of routine vaccines recommended to children. “This is what this country was built on: freedom for parents to make the decisions that best suit their kid,” she said at the signing. “And I’m not anti-vaccine at all. I’m pro-vaccine, but we want to be able to have the freedom to space it out and to choose which one works for our child. We don’t believe that there’s a one-size-fits-all solution for every child.” Franklin is a co-founder of The Conservateur, a media brand for conservative women that includes a lifestyle publication and podcast.
